test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

You must __cut off__ your expenses if you want to save money.
solution:
The correct answer is **cut down on**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the words ***cut down on*** is *to reduce, or lessen.*
 
• The correct sentence will be '*You must **cut down on** your expenses if you want to save money.'*
